headline: 3am. One question. No one awake.
subhead: A free health assistant on gut health, IBD and clinical nutrition, open 24/7.
point1:
3 questions people
ask it at night
point1body:
What does this term in my letter mean
Is what I am feeling worth asking about
What should I ask at my next appointment
note: Ask your question now, free, at any hour.

headline: It will not diagnose you.
subhead: VANCE-Ai gives general information. It is not a diagnosis, prescription or treatment plan.
point1body:
Understanding the words in your letter
Preparing questions before an appointment
General information on gut health topics
note: Ask it anything, then take it to your healthcare team.

headline: The question you felt silly asking.
subhead: No waiting room, no appointment, no sense that you are wasting anyone's time.
point1:
3 things you can ask
without hesitating
point1body:
The question you forgot in the room
The one that felt too small to book for
The word you nodded at but did not know
note: Ask the thing you have been sitting on.

headline: Free. Instant. Always open.
subhead: No cost, no account needed to ask, and no waiting for a reply.
point1:
3 things it does
not ask of you
point1body:
No payment, at any point
No account, unless you want it saved
No waiting for someone to get back to you
note: Start a conversation and see what it can explain.

headline: Urgent? Call 999 or NHS 111.
subhead: VANCE-Ai is for questions, not emergencies. For anything urgent, contact them first.
point1:
3 things to do
before you ask
point1body:
Rule out anything urgent, always
Remember it does not know your history
Plan to check answers with your team
note: Ask when you have a question, not an emergency.

headline: Search results are not answers.
subhead: A search box gives you ten links. This gives you one explanation you can follow.
point1body:
One answer, not ten conflicting pages
Written for gut health specifically
You can ask the follow-up question
note: Bring the question you have already searched twice.

headline: Every chat saves itself.
subhead: Create a free account and every conversation lands in your dashboard automatically.
point1body:
Read back what it explained last month
Take the answers to your appointment
Beside your quiz results and reading list
note: Ask your question and let your dashboard keep it.

headline: You left with more questions.
subhead: Appointments end before the questions do. This one is open when they arise.
point1body:
Walking out of the appointment
Reading a letter days later
The night before the next one
note: Ask what you did not get to ask in the room.

headline: It does not know your history.
subhead: VANCE-Ai answers general questions well. Your own team knows your case.
point1body:
It can be wrong or out of date
It has no access to your records
It replaces no part of your care
note: Ask freely, then check what matters with your team.

headline: Ask it what you actually mean.
subhead: Plain questions on gut health, IBD and clinical nutrition, answered plainly.
point1:
3 kinds of question
it handles well
point1body:
What does this actually mean in practice
Why does this keep coming up in articles
What would be worth asking my clinician
note: Ask it in your own words, free, right now.
